MUS.note: The ministry chatbot MAIA+ takes consultation input; the notice does not say it uses AI.

facts.fact: Mauritius's information technology ministry (MITCI) published its draft Online Child Protection Report on its website and on 15 April 2025 invited public comment by email and through its MAIA+ chatbot, with a 30 April 2025 deadline.
facts.system: Child Online Safety draft report consultation

facts.fact: Mauritius's information technology ministry (MITCI) put its draft child online safety report out for comment on 15 April 2025, inviting parents, educators, youth, civil society organisations, tech companies and the public, with a 30 April 2025 deadline.
facts.system: Child Online Safety draft report consultation
